d: Iran is expanding its missile and drone capabilities amid fears of renewed conflict with the US and Israel, while growing support for nuclear weapons and reported assistance from Russia and China raise further concerns. Iran’s new defence minister, Mehrdad Akhlagchi, known for his expertise in ballistic missiles, is also linked to the development of the Sejjil missile. Meanwhile, tensions may be emerging between US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance over Israel and the Iran war.
